text.autoconfig.renourisheddelight/serve: Enable Nutrition Decay
Whether eating the same food repeatedly shortens how long its bonuses last, recovering as you eat a variety of other foods.
Enable Sleep Food Drain
Whether skipping the night by sleeping drains food, scaled by how much of the night was skipped. Applies to every player, not only the ones who slept.
Grant Nourishment When Full
Whether eating with every slot full and every active food still above 95% grants the Nourishment effect, lasting as long as the shortest active food and warding off harmful effects.
Enable Starvation Effects
Applies the configured starvation effects when the player goes without food.
Enable Sprint Prevention
Prevents the player from sprinting if no food has been consumed.
Player Starting Health
Base max health a player has before any food bonuses are applied.
Consumable Food Limit
Maximum number of foods a player can have active at the same time.
Food Drain Rate
How fast active foods tick down, as a percentage. 100 is normal, 50 is half speed, 0 stops food from draining.
Regeneration Interval
Number of ticks between natural health regeneration. Nourishment makes this three times faster.
Regeneration Damage Delay
Number of ticks to wait after taking damage before natural health regeneration can resume.
Nutrition Decay Rate
Percentage of its duration a food loses each time you eat it, and wins back once it leaves your recently eaten list.
Nutrition Decay Window
How many different foods you must eat before an earlier one starts recovering from its nutrition decay.
Nutrition Decay Floor
Lowest percentage of its configured duration a food can be worn down to by repeated eating.
